summary: Cooling failure at SecureVault Mumbai facility; about 30% of NimbusCloud MUM-1 hosts throttled or powered down.
sourceText:
INCIDENT NOTIFICATION - INITIAL
From: NimbusCloud Infra Pvt Ltd
To: soc@deccanmeridian.example
Sent: 3 November 2026, 16:05 IST
Reference: INC-NC-2026-1103

Summary: At 12:40 IST today, our infrastructure monitoring detected elevated temperatures in Zone B of the SecureVault Mumbai MUM-1 data centre facility. SecureVault engineering determined that primary chilled water circulation pumps had failed.

Approximately 30% of hypervisor hosts in MUM-1 were throttled or powered down to protect hardware. Workloads with multi-zone redundancy have failed over to MUM-2. Single-zone instances in MUM-1 Zone B remain degraded or offline.

Next update: 17:30 IST or upon significant change.

content.situationSummary: A cooling failure at NimbusCloud's colocation subcontractor is degrading the Mumbai region that hosts core banking and digital channels.

immediateActions.title: Confirm with NimbusCloud whether CBS database clusters have failed over

decisionsForAnalyst: Assess whether this meets the RBI cyber incident reporting criteria
questionsForVendor: Which bank workloads were powered down, and when?
content.customerCommunication: Hold; prepare a holding statement for digital banking delays.
